message.content: {"name": "pinger", "summary": "Answer a ping with a pong, then finish.", "states": [{"id": "idle", "kind": "atomic", "parent": "", "purpose": "Wait for a ping."}, {"id": "done", "kind": "final", "parent": "", "purpose": "Finished."}], "events": [{"name": "ping", "direction": "input", "description": "A ping."}, {"name": "pong", "direction": "output", "description": "The answer."}], "transitions": [{"source": "idle", "event": "ping", "target": "done", "description": "Answer and finish."}]}

{"scxml": "<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" datamodel="ecmascript" name="Hourly" initial="waiting">
  <state id="waiting">
    <onentry><send id="every" event="hourly.every" delay="3600s"/></onentry>
    <onexit><cancel sendid="every"/></onexit>
    <transition event="hourly.every" target="waiting">
      <send event="bot.behavior.tick" target="#_parent">
        <content expr="({name: 'Hourly', trigger: 'every', scheduled_at: new Date().toISOString(), fired_at: new Date().toISOString(), output: [{event: 'bot.speaking.say', data: {text: 'Hourly chime.'}}]})"/>
      </send>
    </transition>
  </state>
</scxml>", "schemas": [], "tests": [{"name": "waits", "events": [], "settle_ms": 500, "expect_events": [], "expect_done": false}]}
